During the English winter of 2002–3, she played domestic cricket in Australia for Western Australia.  She returned to the England team in early 2003, but after a back problem forced her to undergo surgery, she did not play for England again.  Her final international appearance was a Test match against Australia in late February 2003.  She played domestic cricket for Cheshire in 2005.  She completed her career with 24 wickets in ODI cricket at an average of 29.33, and 8 wickets in Test cricket at 50.62.
